Back-end DTI. breakdown = [{label, value, source(stated|extracted|computed|manual), from_tag}] so code sees HOW it was built + traces each line to its tag.
LTV. breakdown lines: loan_amount, purchase_price, appraised_value, value_basis — each with source + from_tag.
CLTV/HCLTV. breakdown includes HELOC credit-limit line (from_tag liab.heloc_credit_limit).
MI premium. breakdown: base_loan, factor(from_tag mi.factor), monthly_premium.
Reserves in months PITIA. breakdown: eligible_assets(from_tag asset.usable_value), monthly_pitia, months.
Cash to close. breakdown: down_payment, closing_costs, credits, required_reserves, available_funds, shortfall.
EACH breakdown line carries from_tag = the tag id that produced its value (or 'spec'/'note-derived'). Makes every calc line traceable to a fact-tag with its confidence.
Provenance of each breakdown line (carried from the existing calculators).
